caption:
Two days off… but Monday still feels exhausting? 😴💼

Rest alone doesn’t always reset your energy. Your sleep quality, movement, weekend routine, hydration, and daily habits all play a role in how you feel when the workweek begins.

If Monday fatigue keeps showing up, focus on the basics:
😴 Better sleep — keep your sleep and wake times more consistent
🚶 More movement — don’t let the entire weekend become completely inactive
💧 Stay hydrated — low hydration can make you feel more sluggish
📅 Smarter routine — prepare your body for Monday instead of shocking it back into work mode

title: Your shoulder press should build your shoulders—not turn into a low-back lean.
hook: Your shoulder press should build your shoulders—not turn into a low-back lean.
caption:
Your shoulder press should build your shoulders—not turn into a low-back lean.

Use these simple checks before adding weight:

1. Build a stable base
Keep your feet planted, wrists neutral, and torso supported.

2. Press with control
Move smoothly up and lower under control. Keep your ribs stacked over your pelvis.

3. Keep the range comfortable
Use a range you can control without pain or compensating with your back.

If you have to lean back to finish the rep, lower the weight or reduce the range.

Save this for shoulder day.
